svg.title: Protect Removal Cash in a $45,000 Startup Plan
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-45000-reference; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Protect Removal Cash in a $45,000 Startup Plan; subtitle: Four buckets: $15,000 lean, $45,000 reference, $80,000 expanded; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values show the $45,000 central/reference startup budget in USD, within the canonical $15,000–$80,000 range. Each stage also provides its allocation at the $15,000 lean minimum and $80,000 expanded maximum. The allocation percentages are illustrative and sum to 100% at every capital level. Startup deployment is not annual revenue or annual expense.; caption: Lean: $9,000 + $2,250 + $1,500 + $2,250 = $15,000. Reference: $27,000 + $6,750 + $4,500 + $6,750 = $45,000. Expanded: $48,000 + $12,000 + $8,000 + $12,000 = $80,000.; stages: label: Acquisition working capital; value: 60%; $27,000 reference allocation; numeric value: 27000.0; detail: Allocate $9,000 in the $15,000 lean plan, $27,000 in the $45,000 reference plan, and $48,000 in the $80,000 expanded plan. Cover hammer prices, premiums, and acquisition cash obligations while limiting concentration in any single lot or buyer segment.; label: Removal and repair float; value: 15%; $6,750 reference allocation; numeric value: 6750.0; detail: Allocate $2,250 in the $15,000 lean plan, $6,750 in the $45,000 reference plan, and $12,000 in the $80,000 expanded plan. Ring-fence loading, freight, inspection, testing, and bounded repair payments that fall due before resale collections.; label: Facilities and operating setup; value: 10%; $4,500 reference allocation; numeric value: 4500.0; detail: Allocate $1,500 in the $15,000 lean plan, $4,500 in the $45,000 reference plan, and $8,000 in the $80,000 expanded plan. Fund appropriately scaled storage deposits, insurance setup, safety equipment, inventory controls, and required business registrations.; label: Liquidity and holding reserve; value: 15%; $6,750 reference allocation; numeric value: 6750.0; detail: Allocate $2,250 in the $15,000 lean plan, $6,750 in the $45,000 reference plan, and $12,000 in the $80,000 expanded plan. Preserve cash for delayed collections, additional storage, and operating disruptions; calculate runway from actual monthly burn rather than assuming six months are funded.
